diff_summary: The join separator was swapped: `"_".join(filename.split())` became `" ".join(filename.split())`.
why_its_a_bug: The split/join is what turns runs of whitespace into underscores. Joining with a space puts the whitespace straight back, and the strip regex then deletes those spaces entirely -- so 'My cool movie.mov' becomes 'Mycoolmovie.mov' and the path-separator neutralisation (which relies on separators becoming spaces first) silently collapses too.
hint_level_description: Filenames with no whitespace survive intact. Follow what happens to a name containing spaces, and note that path separators are deliberately turned into spaces earlier in the function.
